text.autoconfig.effectual.option.airTrai: Leaves a subtle trail while gliding with Elytra.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.blockPl: Particles appear when placing snow, sand, or gravel, matching the placed block.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.bubbleB: Creates bubbles when breathing underwater, as long as the player has an oxygen supply.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.bubbleC: Bubbles occasionally rise from an open underwater chest.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.bubbleP: If a decorated pot is underwater, it occasionally releases bubbles.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.campfir: New spark particles from campfires and soul campfires.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.cauldro: Splash/smoke particles when filling cauldrons with water, lava, or powder snow.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.caveDus: How often dust appears in caves (higher = more).
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.dynamic: If enabled, breathing (in cold biomes) speeds up when sprinting or jumping.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.fireEnt: When an entity is on fire (e.g. in lava or flames), sparks will fly out of it.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.fireImp: New spark particles from fire and soul fire.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.furnace: Tiny sparks from furnaces and blast furnaces while lit.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.lantern: New spark particles from lanterns and soul lanterns.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.metalHi: When hitting a metal block with a metal weapon or tool, sparks appear.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.minecar: Sparks appear when minecarts move at high speed.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.mouthSt: Adds visible breath steam in cold biomes.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.runDust: Creates additional dust particles when running on sand or snow.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.snowFoo: Leaves visible footprints when walking on snow.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.snowRes: Leaves small snow patches on the ground after walking off snow.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.steamEf: When water touches hot blocks (such as lava or a cauldron with lava), it creates a steam jet.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.stripEf: Particles appear when stripping logs with an axe.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.torchIm: New spark particles from torches and soul torches.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.waterDr: When the player exits water, droplets fall from them.
text.autoconfig.effectual.option.witherD: Adds black smoke while Wither effect is active (only visible on yourself).
text.autoconfig.effectual.title: Effectual Settings
